verses.text: Ascribe unto Jehovah, O ye sons of the mighty, Ascribe unto Jehovah glory and strength.

segments.text: Ascribe unto Jehovah, O ye sons of the mighty,
Ascribe unto Jehovah glory and strength.

verses.text: Ascribe unto Jehovah the glory due unto his name; Worship Jehovah in holy array.

segments.text: Ascribe unto Jehovah the glory due unto his name;
Worship Jehovah in holy array.

verses.text: The voice of Jehovah is upon the waters: The God of glory thundereth, Even Jehovah upon many waters.

segments.text: The voice of Jehovah is upon the waters:
The God of glory thundereth,

verses.text: The voice of Jehovah is powerful; The voice of Jehovah is full of majesty.

segments.text: The voice of Jehovah is powerful;

verses.text: The voice of Jehovah breaketh the cedars; Yea, Jehovah breaketh in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.

segments.text: The voice of Jehovah breaketh the cedars;

verses.text: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young wild-ox.

segments.text: He maketh them also to skip like a calf;

verses.text: The voice of Jehovah cleaveth the flames of fire.

segments.text: The voice of Jehovah cleaveth the flames of fire.

verses.text: The voice of Jehovah shaketh the wilderness; Jehovah shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.

segments.text: The voice of Jehovah shaketh the wilderness;

verses.text: The voice of Jehovah maketh the hinds to calve, And strippeth the forests bare: And in his temple everything saith, Glory.

segments.text: The voice of Jehovah maketh the hinds to calve,

verses.text: Jehovah sat as King at the Flood; Yea, Jehovah sitteth as King for ever.

verses.text: Jehovah will give strength unto his people; Jehovah will bless his people with peace.
